pipeline_up: 1. Voxel sort (local, 99.7%) → classify entities into 7×7×3 cells
2. Each cell → bingo cell address (scale × epitope × type)
3. Bingo cells → circulatory lymph nodes (the visualization nodes)
4. Entity flows between cells → lymph vessels (the visualization edges)
5. Cell occupancy → node size/color in circulatory view
6. Flow rate between cells → vessel thickness in circulatory view
7. Layer coupling = sum of flows crossing layer boundaries
pipeline_down: 1. Anderson W per layer → filter strength for incoming traffic
3. Opsonize tags → bubble banana gate (redirect pure consumers)
4. Human epitope sort → territory × depth grid (4×5=20 cells)
6. Neutron flow → structural connections (even without humans)
7. Family rotation → wake level → perturbation → observation depth

philosophy.waterfall: the world sorts us. gravity. cosmic rays. solar wind. weather. each layer filters.
philosophy.fountain: we sort the world. measurement. publication. outreach. each layer adds context.
philosophy.circulation: waterfall + fountain = circulatory system. the sort breathes.
philosophy.fractal: zoom in → more structure. each bingo cell contains its own voxel sort.
philosophy.bottleneck: dead coupling = where the fountain hasn't reached. the pump grows slowly.
philosophy.model: Atmosphere↔Magnetosphere (0.664) is the WORKING EXAMPLE. replicate this.
